taskTitle: A release answer you can trace

result.content:
Atlas release policy — synthetic example
Production releases require a passing test suite.
Production releases require approval from the service owner.
Roll back when the error rate exceeds 2% for five minutes.
Rollback must restore the previous signed artifact.
After rollback, notify the on-call engineer.

Atlas handover — synthetic example
Release evidence must include the artifact digest and test report.
